title: NBA Offseason Daily Digest
subtitle: September 26, 2026 – Trades, Free Agency, and Season Previews

items.headline: Steph Curry Signs $116M Extension with Warriors
items.summary: Golden State Warriors superstar Stephen Curry has reportedly agreed to a two-year, $116 million contract extension, securing his future with the franchise through the 2028-29 season. The 38-year-old guard is set to play his 19th and potentially 20th season with the Warriors, cementing his legacy with the only team he's ever played for.

items.headline: LeBron James Details 76ers Move, Eyes Championship Run
items.summary: LeBron James has opened up about his blockbuster move to the Philadelphia 76ers, expressing a strong desire for a championship. James, who turns 42 in December, cited the presence of Tyrese Maxey and Joel Embiid as key factors in his decision to join the Eastern Conference contender.

items.headline: Karl-Anthony Towns, Knicks Reach Contract Stalemate
items.summary: Negotiations between Karl-Anthony Towns and the New York Knicks on a contract extension have reportedly hit a snag. Towns, who was an integral part of the Knicks' championship success last season, is eligible for a four-year, $276 million extension.

items.headline: Clippers Hit with Major Sanctions Over Cap Scandal
items.summary: In a decision announced on September 2, the LA Clippers were stripped of five first-round draft picks (2029-2033) and fined $30 million following a salary cap scandal. Owner Steve Ballmer also received a one-year suspension from league activities.

items.headline: NBA Eyeing European Expansion with Rome as Potential Hub
items.summary: The NBA is reportedly planning to establish a significant presence in Europe starting in 2027, with Rome emerging as a key city for potential expansion. The league is targeting 12 European cities for franchises in a closed league model.

items.headline: 2026-27 NBA Regular Season to Tip Off October 20th
items.summary: Fans can mark their calendars as the 2026-27 NBA regular season is officially scheduled to commence on Tuesday, October 20, 2026. Training camps for all 30 teams will open earlier, on September 29th.
